record.kind: on-simulation-start effect; the unit copies the opponent player's top synergy
record.summary: Passive.CONVERSION has one PassiveEffects entry, conversionEffect, an OnSimulationStartEffect. Nothing happens when the entity has no Player (PvE or ghost) or is a spawned entity, or when the other side has no player. Otherwise it takes the opponent player's single top synergy (getTopSynergies(1): highest level, ties broken by the number of thresholds reached) and does nothing if the entity already has that type. If not, the type is added to the entity's types, and the first effect of that synergy's tier list that the opponent's effects contain (else the synergy's first tier effect) is applied to the entity through simulation.applyEffect. Synergy-specific extras follow: BUG creates a clone of the same Pokémon (as a spawn, so it does not convert again) in the closest free cell; DRAGON adds a shield of 5 x the dragon stars on the opponent team when the selected effect is DRAGON_SCALES or DRAGON_DANCE, and with DRAGON_DANCE also adds AP and SPEED equal to that dragon level; GHOST requests +0.15 dodge chance; GOURMET adds a Chef Hat if the entity holds fewer than 3 items; GROUND sets the entity's own cell to hole level 5 in the player's groundHoles; FLORA registers an on-death effect that spawns Jumpluff / Victreebel / Meganium / Vileplume for the opponent's flora tier 1 / 2 / 3 / 4 at the farthest available place. All of these amounts are requested values: they go through addShield / addAbilityPower / addSpeed / addDodgeChance with the Porygon as its own caster and AP boost 0, so a Big Eater Belt on the Porygon would multiply the positive amount (dodge with 3-digit rounding) and the dodge value is capped at 0.9; the applied change is not computed here. Separately, inSpotlight treats a CONVERSION unit that has the LIGHT type and no Light Ball as in the spotlight.
triggers: Simulation start, once per Porygon entity (OnSimulationStartEffect)
FLORA only: death of the converted entity (OnDeathEffect added at start)

conditions: No effect without a Player on the entity, with isSpawn true, or without an opponent player.
No effect when the entity already has the copied synergy.
The copied synergy is the opponent player's top one at the start of the fight; with ties the sort order decides, then pickRandomIn on a one-element list.
Dragon extras depend on which tier effect was selected; the flora spawn depends on the opponent's flora tier read once at the start.
Stars do not change the passive: all three units run the same function.
record.resetBehaviour: No stored state across fights; the added type and effect exist on the fight entity only (entity.types.add, not the board Pokémon).
